name: Author can sign in and see the workspace overview

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123!: clear the Email field (input#login-email) and type alex.rivera@soply.test, clear the Password field (input#login-password) and type Soply123!, then click the 'Sign in' button
The workspace overview loads with the heading 'Good to see you, Alex' and a metric card labeled 'Published SOPs'
The sidebar shows the nav items Overview, SOP library, Approval queue, and Version history
